data.name: Kibo and the Cursed Lands
data.detailed_description: Thalmyra, a land once existing in harmony, has become fractured. Every day, its nations grow more distant, more secluded. Its inhabitants are sick, plagued with a deadly disease known as The Rot. It makes the land uninhabitable, the animals feral, the people slowly wither away. What’s worse, there’s no cure - infection is paramount to a death sentence. Well, Kibo doesn’t plan to go quietly. With nimble movements, dynamic attacks and powerful elemental weapons, join him as he searches for a cure, outsmarting or overpowering every obstacle that tries to get in his way. He’ll find a way to save himself from this plague; he has no other choice.

data.short_description: Kibo and the Cursed Lands is an enchanting, single-player action RPG set in the land of Thalmyra. Play as Kibo the desperate wanderer and traverse obstacles, fight through enemies and wield unique, elemental weapons in order to find a cure for this ever-growing threat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590 (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: The game is developed in Unity 2022.3 using the Universal Render Pipeline (URP), which requires at least DirectX 11 compatibility on Windows. Minimum specs may be adjusted as performance testing expands to additional hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT (8 GB VRAM or higher) or better Support DirectX 12, Vulkan, and Shader Model 5
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound device with support for 5.1 surround sound or better
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: SSD storage is recommended for fast loading and smooth asset streaming in the semi-open world environment. Surround sound capable audio hardware is recommended for best audio immersion, though stereo output is fully supported.
